Osborne Partners Capital Management Holds Stake in Now (DNOW); Apple (AAPL) Shareholder Rockland Trust Co Has Decreased Stake by $354,708
June 10, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Osborne Partners Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Now Inc (DNOW) by 12.66% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Osborne Partners Capital Management Llc bought 48,695 shares as the company’s stock rose 38.19% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 433,190 shares of the metal fabrications company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.43 million, up from 384,495 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Osborne Partners Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Now Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.49 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.85% or $0.26 $13.81. About 895,715 shares traded. NOW Inc. (NYSE:DNOW) has declined 17.42% since June 10, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 29.99% the S&P500.
